mobile.keep_versions_hint: How long the previous copy of a file replaced by sync is kept; 0 keeps none. A last-resort copy, separate from the memo history.

mobile.repeat_mismatch: The two passwords do not match

mobile.setup_question: How would you like to start?
mobile.sync_unavailable: Sync is unavailable in this build
mobile.unlock_days_hint: Opens without the password for this long; 0 asks every time. Meanwhile anyone who can unlock the phone can read your memos.

mobile.update_check_hint: Asks GitHub once a day whether a newer version exists. Nothing about you or your memos is sent, but your address does reach GitHub.
mobile.watch_delay_hint: Waits this long after an edit before sending it, so a burst of typing is not sent one keystroke at a time.
mobile.wifi_only_hint: Waits while on mobile data or a metered Wi-Fi, and catches up the moment you are back on Wi-Fi.
